tasks.short: Design computer systems and their software

steps.what: Establish computers' research requirements, interfaces and physical constraints
Design candidate hardware and software interfaces against the constraints

loop.purpose: Propose a bounded candidate architecture and document trade-offs
loop.input: Scientist-authored constraints, interfaces and selected technical references
loop.output: Candidate design with assumptions and source-linked rationale
loop.check: Scientist traces every interface and performance claim to constraints and checks architectural consistency independently
loop.stop: Two candidates and one revision; unsupported designs return to manual design
loop.why_not_simpler: Research architecture involves alternatives that cannot be selected by field substitution

steps.what: Evaluate architecture trade-offs and accept the research design

tasks.design: Keep constraints and design acceptance with the scientist in {DOCS}. A bounded model proposes candidate interfaces and rationale for independent technical assessment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Candidate design drafting is intertwined with technical invention and verification.
tasks.enabler_now: A model can draft alternatives within a supplied technical brief, without establishing their correctness.
tasks.still_hard: Prove that the architecture satisfies novel physical and computational constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the abstraction and reject plausible but invalid designs.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less candidate drafting; research judgement and decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: GitHub Copilot supports coding and review with oversight; this is adjacent capability, not evidence of autonomous computer architecture research.
Model knowledge: bounded architecture drafting may save a small share after independent review; the proposed time estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is research design, excluding implementation, hardware fabrication and deployment. No implementation baseline is invented.

The scientist produces interface definitions, workload assumptions, physical limits, acceptance criteria and reference provenance in s1, with full capture and verification time retained. Missing constraints return to manual research; there is no free structured feasibility flag.
Test existing native document and design features before custom code. Candidate drafts cannot change live systems.
Any implementation or release approval remains a separate existing process and gains no claimed saving.
unknowns: Nature of the computer research and available technical references
Whether candidate drafting is a meaningful separable effort
research_questions: Does independent review of proposed architectures cost more than the draft time avoided?

incremental.description: Maintain technical context and inspect failure patterns

approvals.approved_version: Exact architecture revision, constraints, interfaces, assumptions and unresolved risks accepted after review; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+28+30=93; gross=7, focal incremental=5, net=2. Range 0-1 allows novel hardware interfaces to require nearly complete manual redesign; fabrication and implementation are excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Formulate mathematical models of technical problems

steps.what: Conduct logical analyses and define the problem's variables and assumptions
Formulate mathematical models and candidate solution arguments

loop.input: Defined variables, domains, objectives, constraints and known counterexamples
loop.check: Scientist independently derives key implications, checks units and limiting cases, and tests counterexamples against the real problem
loop.stop: One formulation and one revision; failed or unverifiable arguments return to manual derivation
loop.why_not_simpler: Choosing a useful abstraction requires mathematical interpretation beyond symbolic substitution

steps.what: Validate model assumptions and establish the solution's limits

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} to keep the problem definition beside a bounded candidate formulation. The scientist retains independent derivation, counterexamples and conclusions about validity.
tasks.previous_blocker: A plausible equation can encode the wrong problem.
tasks.enabler_now: Language models can suggest formulations for a scientist to challenge.
tasks.still_hard: Establish mathematical correctness and whether assumptions match reality.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an invalid abstraction and construct a decisive counterexample.
tasks.altitude: More review of candidate formulations, with unchanged scientific responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded model can propose mathematical formulations, but this establishes neither correctness nor a measured research productivity gain.

assumptions: Boundary covers logical analysis and formulation, excluding data collection, large experiment execution and downstream deployment.

The scientist produces variable definitions, units, domains, objectives, constraints and evidence provenance in s1; capture and clarification remain in its full 45%. Missing definitions stop assisted formulation and return to manual analysis.
Use native mathematical authoring and symbolic checking facilities first; deterministic checks can verify stated relations but cannot choose the scientific abstraction.
Research design and mathematical formulation shared with task 14633 must be assigned once in a roll-up.
unknowns: Problem domain and availability of independent validation methods
research_questions: Can scientists find formulation errors faster than they could derive the formulation unaided?

already_counted.description: Independent checking and correction of candidate equations

incremental.description: Maintain examples and review recurring formulation failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+24.5+20=89.5; gross=10.5, focal incremental=5, net=5.5. Range 0-2 assumes novel formulations or difficult proof checking erase most drafting gains; scientific validation time is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate project plans and proposals to assess feasibility issues

tasks.design: Keep feasibility assessment with the scientist, using the proposal and evidence in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. No removable proposal-processing share is assumed from this broad evaluation task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research feasibility depends on uncertain evidence and unproven methods.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access supports the assessment; no change is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish a tractable research uncertainty from a fatal dependency.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge optimistic assumptions and state what evidence would change the verdict.
tasks.altitude: Assessment work and sponsor decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess a data dependency in a proposal

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: evaluating uncertain research feasibility remains judgement work; no local clerical baseline or productivity improvement is established.

assumptions: Boundary is the scientist's assessment, excluding sponsor funding decisions and proposal authorship.

The project proposer supplies the proposal before evaluation. The scientist verifies claimed milestones, resources, dependencies and technical evidence within s1; missing evidence requires manual clarification there. No structured feasibility score or complete evidence set is assumed.
Test native document and project views before custom tools; no new configuration is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing assessment process is unchanged.
research_questions: Does observed assessment contain a separable repetitive extraction step worth redesigning?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Straightforward and uncertain proposals retain the full evaluation time; no extraction baseline has been demonstrated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Participate in multidisciplinary projects and reconcile technical contributions

tasks.design: Keep multidisciplinary participation with the scientist, using shared {PROJECT} and {DOCS} records. The task gives no distinct administrative baseline to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different disciplines use different assumptions and standards of evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation is proposed for the collaboration itself.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve disagreements and adapt experiments when disciplines expose conflicting constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Build shared understanding and contribute scientific judgement.
tasks.altitude: Participation and research authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Agree how to interpret an experiment

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: multidisciplinary participation is broader than document production and cannot be assigned a generic drafting saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers scientific participation and coordination, excluding separately counted implementation and formal study approval.

Collaborators produce their observations and constraints during the project before joint interpretation; the scientist elicits and checks meaning within s1. No ready-made agreed requirements or clean experimental findings are assumed.
Review existing native collaboration facilities before custom tooling; none is added.
Incremental upkeep is zero because collaboration is unchanged. Mathematical derivation or architecture design already counted under other tasks must not be counted here again.
unknowns: Project disciplines and actual coordination burdens
research_questions: Which observed activities are collaboration itself and which are separately measurable document work?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0 with zero upkeep. Both routine collaboration and conflicting experimental interpretations retain human participation time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Bounded candidate drafting supports research; problem choice, proof, feasibility and collaboration remain human responsibilities.
reach: Work with statisticians and architects to test assumptions and interfaces.
role.ambitious_version: A scientist who can challenge more candidate ideas without outsourcing scientific judgement.
